distribution.dispersion: single global parameter estimated from training data only

calibration.type: Platt logistic calibration on logit raw home-win probability
calibration.fit_policy: chronologically later calibration window, never evaluation games

training_protocol: expanding rolling origin; all features and parameters strictly prior
prospective_reserve: 2026 outcomes excluded from selection and calibration
known_limitations: Historical lineups reconstruct actual starters rather than archived T-minus-30 states.
Extra innings do not model ghost runners, innings, or relievers explicitly.
Observed completed-game weather is not an accepted model input.
Retrospective 2021-2025 results are development evidence, not prospective validation.
